description: This file defines the 'History' class within the AWS SDK for PHP, which manages a container for storing command, request, and response history, including methods for retrieving last entries, starting/stopping entries, and maintaining size limits.

classes.name: History
classes.description: A container class for managing the history of AWS SDK commands, requests, and responses, supporting counting, iteration, and bounded storage.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the History object with an optional max entries limit (default 10).

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of entries stored in the history.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator to traverse the history entries.

methods.name: getLastCommand
methods.description: Retrieves the last command executed, throws exception if none.

methods.name: getLastRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the last request sent, throws exception if none.

methods.name: getLastReturn
methods.description: Retrieves the last returned result or exception, throws if none.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins a new history entry with a command and request, returning a ticket ID.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Completes a history entry identified by the ticket, storing the result or exception, and trims if exceeding max entries.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all entries from the history.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns all current history entries as an array.
